steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Julius Caesar raided Britain in 55 and 54 BCE but did not establish permanent occupation | Key Fact: Emperor Claudius invaded Britain in 43 CE to gain military prestige and legitimise his reign | Key Fact: Caractacus led British resistance but was defeated and taken to Rome in chains | Key Fact: Boudica of the Iceni led a major revolt in 60-61 CE after Roman brutality towards her family
